color.docs:
**string**: The LED color to activate. For R503, one of `RED`, `BLUE` and `PURPLE`. For R503-RGB, one of `RED`, `BLUE`, `PURPLE`, `GREEN`, `YELLOW`, `CYAN` and `WHITE`.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

count.docs:
**int**: How many times to repeat the pattern. Only relevant for `BREATHING` and `FLASHING` states. 0 for infinite, or 1 to 255.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

speed.docs:
**int**: The duration each cycle lasts, a factor of 10ms. Only relevant for `BREATHING`, `FLASHING`, `GRADUAL_ON` and `GRADUAL_OFF` states. The total duration is defined by 10ms *speed* count. Range is 0 to 255.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

state.docs:
**string**: The state to set the LED. One of `BREATHING`, `FLASHING`, `ALWAYS_ON`, `ALWAYS_OFF`, `GRADUAL_ON` and `GRADUAL_OFF`.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

aura_led_control.docs: Controls the Aura LED on the reader. Only available on select models. NOTE: The R503 has 2 variants with different LED colour options.

cancel_enroll.docs: Cancels the current fingerprint enrollment process. Triggers the `on_enrollment_failed` trigger.

finger_id.docs:
**int**: The slot number of the enrolled fingerprint to delete.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

delete.docs: Removes the enrolled fingerprint from the slot number defined.

finger_id.docs:
**int**: The slot number to enroll the new fingerprint into. Limited to the fingerprint capacity available on the reader.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

num_scans.docs:
**int**: Number of times to scan the finger to be enrolled. Limited to the number of character buffers available on the reader. Defaults to 2.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

enroll.docs: Starts the fingerprint enrollment process on the slot number defined.

state.docs:
**boolean**: The state to set the LED.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

led_control.docs: Turns on or off the LED on the reader. Only available on select models. If you have the R503 or R503-RGB use [`fingerprint_grow.aura_led_control` Action](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-aura_led_control) instead.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

idle_period_to_sleep.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The sensor idle period to wait before powering it off (sleep). Defaults to `5s`. See [Sleep Mode](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#sleep-mode) for more information.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

new_password.docs:
**int**: Sets a new password to use for authentication. See [Setting a New Password](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-set_new_password) for more information.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_enrollment_done.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when a fingerprint is enrolled. See [`on_enrollment_done` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_enrollment_done).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_enrollment_failed.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when a fingerprint enrollment failed. See [`on_enrollment_failed` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_enrollment_failed).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_enrollment_scan.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when a fingerprint is scanned during enrollment. See [`on_enrollment_scan` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_enrollment_scan).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_finger_scan_invalid.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when the scan of a fingerprint failed. See [`on_finger_scan_invalid` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_finger_scan_invalid).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_finger_scan_matched.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when an enrolled fingerprint is scanned. See [`on_finger_scan_matched` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_finger_scan_matched).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_finger_scan_misplaced.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when the finger is not entirely touching the sensor. See [`on_finger_scan_misplaced` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_finger_scan_misplaced).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_finger_scan_start.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when the finger touches the sensor. See [`on_finger_scan_start` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_finger_scan_start).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

on_finger_scan_unmatched.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An action to be performed when an unknown fingerprint is scanned. See [`on_finger_scan_unmatched` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#fingerprint_grow-on_finger_scan_unmatched).

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

password.docs:
**int**: Password to use for authentication. Defaults to `0x00`.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

sensing_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Pin connected to the reader's finger detection signal (WAKEUP) output.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

sensor_power_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Output pin responsible for toogling the sensor power on and off.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the UART hub.

*See also: [Grow Fingerprint Reader](https://esphome.io/components/fingerprint_grow#configuration-variables)*
